The estate

Room to gather, space to disappear

Two houses around a large pool, wide lawns shaded by mature cedars, and enough separate living spaces that a group of twenty never feels crowded. You book the entire estate — no other guests, no shared facilities, no schedule but your own.

Spaces

Built for group life

Sleeping, eating, practising and unwinding each have their own dedicated space — so sessions, meals and downtime can run in parallel without anyone tripping over each other.

Main house — 5 bedrooms

Five bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and garden views, plus an office and seven bathrooms across the estate.

Pool house — 2 bedrooms

A separate two-bedroom house on the pool deck — ideal for facilitators, chefs or guests who want their own quiet corner.

Studio floor

A full attic level with warm wooden floors and skylights: a natural yoga or workshop studio, with three further rooms that convert to bedrooms for larger groups.

The great room

A vast open living room with a fireplace, a table that seats the whole group, and space to circle up chairs for sessions and sharing rounds.

Second lounge & games

A second large living room with billiards — downtime that doesn't compete with the workshop space.

Spa & pool

An indoor jacuzzi and shower room in marble, and a 12-metre outdoor pool with a full sun deck, loungers and parasols.

A day here

How your retreat flows through the estate

Every space has a job, so your programme moves without friction — sessions, meals and downtime running in parallel.

  • 07:30Morning practice — on the lawn as the sun clears the pines, or in the attic studio.
  • 09:00Breakfast — the whole group at the long table.
  • 10:30Workshop block — studio upstairs; the great room for seminars and sharing circles.
  • 13:00Long lunch — dining room or out on the porch.
  • 15:00Open afternoon — pool, jacuzzi, forest walks from the gate, or a coastal excursion.
  • 18:00Evening session — restorative practice as the light goes gold.
  • 20:00Dinner & fire — chef-cooked if you've added it, fireside circle after.
Getting here

Easy to reach, hard to leave

The estate sits in Pocariça, near Cantanhede — countryside quiet, yet motorway-close to two international airports, Coimbra and the Atlantic beaches.

  • Porto Airport (OPO)
    ≈ 1 h 20 by car — direct on the A1/A17
  • Lisbon Airport (LIS)
    ≈ 2 h by car
  • Coimbra
    ≈ 30 min — UNESCO university city
  • Atlantic beaches
    ≈ 25–30 min — Praia da Mira & Figueira da Foz
  • Quinta da Pocariça
    3060-197 Pocariça, Cantanhede

Airport shuttle available as an add-on — one bus, door to door, for the whole group. Arriving by car? On-site parking for up to 15 vehicles.

  • Porto day trip — old town, port cellars & Douro river (≈ 1 h 15)
  • Aveiro — the "Portuguese Venice", canals & art nouveau (≈ 40 min)
  • Bairrada wine region — sparkling wine & leitão at your doorstep
  • Luso & Buçaco forest — thermal springs and walking trails (≈ 35 min)

FAQ

Good questions, straight answers

Do we get the whole property to ourselves?

Yes. Every booking is exclusive use of the entire estate — main house, pool house, studio floor, spa, pool and grounds. No other guests, ever.

How many people can stay?

Seven bedrooms sleep 14 guests comfortably across the main house and pool house. The studio floor has three further rooms that convert to bedrooms, taking total capacity to around 20.

Where can we hold sessions?

The attic studio floor is the natural workshop space, the great room seats the full group for seminars and sharing circles, and the lawns fit outdoor practice for 20+ with the pool deck as a break-out area.

Is food included?

The estate is self-catered by default, with a full kitchen and a dining room that seats everyone. Most retreat leaders add the private chef for full board — one less thing to run.

How do guests without cars get there?

Book the airport shuttle add-on and we collect the whole group from Porto or Lisbon airport in one private bus. Independent arrivals can take the train to Coimbra or Cantanhede and taxi from there.

How does booking work?

Send your dates and group size through the form below. We confirm availability and a firm quote within 24 hours; a deposit secures the dates and the balance is due before arrival.

Is the venue suitable for winter retreats?

Yes — the houses have central heating and fireplaces throughout, and the indoor jacuzzi earns its keep in the cooler months. Central Portugal stays mild for most of the year.
